# Export table of the SD-card apps (#519): what an app's ELF may resolve against the OS. Generated by
# `tools/gen_export_table.py --write` from the lichen_api headers, the peer headers, tools/export_allow.txt and
# the forbid lines of tools/layers.conf; checked on every build. Changing it needs a LICHEN_API_VERSION bump:
# major when a line is removed or changed, minor when one is added (lichen_api_version.h).
# export<TAB>name<TAB>symbol<TAB>origin (header, or allow); wrap<TAB>X<TAB>__wrap_X: every -Wl,--wrap=X.
